explication: Homebrew Core is the default catalog of formula definitions used by `brew install`. A user asks Homebrew to install a named formula; Homebrew consults the catalog, resolves declared dependencies, obtains source or a bottle, and executes the formula’s installation recipe to produce installed software. The tree shows a very large, diverse catalog, while sampled files show several recipe styles rather than Homebrew’s runtime implementation. The graph therefore emphasizes the documented install workflow and representative formulae; it does not infer internal Homebrew call wiring.
